name: parity-inventory-check
command:
import csv,pathlib,re
rows=list(csv.DictReader(pathlib.Path('@prime/UI_MODULES.csv').open(encoding='utf8')))
ids={r['module_id'] for r in rows}
assert len(ids)==len(rows)==60
valid_tasks=set(re.findall(r'\b(?:UI\d+-\d+|WEB-WELCOME|WEB-OPT|DESKTOP-LATER)\b',pathlib.Path('@prime/UI_PHASES.md').read_text(encoding='utf8')))
covered=set();graph={}
for r in rows:
 deps=[v.strip() for v in r['depends_on_modules'].split(';') if v.strip()]
 assert set(deps)<=ids,(r['module_id'],deps)
 graph[r['module_id']]=deps
 tasks={v.strip() for v in r['ui_tasks'].split(';') if v.strip()};assert tasks<=valid_tasks,(r['module_id'],tasks);covered|=tasks
 if r['path_state']=='EXISTING':
  for path in r['path'].split(';'):assert pathlib.Path(path.strip()).exists(),path
 assert set(r['main_phases'].split(';'))<=set('P'+str(i) for i in range(11))
seen=set();visiting=set()
def visit(x):
 assert x not in visiting,('cycle',x)
 if x in seen:return
 visiting.add(x)
 for dep in graph[x]:visit(dep)
 visiting.remove(x);seen.add(x)
for x in ids:visit(x)
assert valid_tasks<=covered,valid_tasks-covered
print(f'UI inventory: {len(ids)} unique modules, {len(covered)} tasks, dependencies acyclic, EXISTING paths and phase maps OK')
